definitions.explanation: The money paid or to be paid for goods or services.

examples.japanese: ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{代金|だいきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: To pay the price for goods.

examples.japanese: {代金|だいきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{請求|せいきゅう}→請求：03374_seikyuu⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The payment will be billed later.

examples.japanese: ⟦{代金引換|だいきんひきかえ}→代金引換：28163_daikinhikikae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: It will be delivered cash on delivery.
examples.notes: 代金引換 = cash on delivery (COD)

notes:
{代金|だいきん} refers to the money paid or owed in exchange for specific goods or services. It implies a transactional context — the price of something being bought or sold.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {代金|だいきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay the price
- {代金|だいきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to receive payment
- ⟦{代金引換|だいきんひきかえ}→代金引換：28163_daikinhikikae⟧: cash on delivery (COD)
- {代金|だいきん}⟦{請求|せいきゅう}→請求：03374_seikyuu⟧: billing, invoice for payment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧: price (what something costs, general)
- ⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: fee, charge (for services like electricity or transport)
- ⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧: amount of money (a specific numerical sum)
- ⟦{対価|たいか}→対価：12434_taika⟧: compensation, consideration (formal/legal)
